topic: Face-Area Ratios and the K-Field Mass Bridge
audience: High-school seniors; first-principles teaching, with concrete prerequisite capabilities and taught bridges.
prerequisites: Signed arithmetic, fractions, ratios, powers, linear equations, and coordinate graphs
learning_outcomes: Prove scale invariance of two independent area ratios
Evaluate source-defined constants with units and provenance
Track distinct numerical witnesses without silently merging them
Separate an algebraic ratio from a proposed physical identification
Propagate a small input change and report the full closure difference
requested_deliverables: capstone.md with full answers and rubric
assumptions: A topical short course, not a semester per topic. Pacing is 55-minute core lessons plus capstone periods; split dense lessons if actual learner load requires it.
No prior calculus, abstract algebra, university linear algebra, or quantum mechanics unless explicitly taught earlier.
Required core assessments must be solvable with taught finite examples. Clearly label deeper recognition-only extensions.
Markdown is the delivery format; no PDF or Word generation is required.

teaching_anchor.bridge_to_teach: Recall labeled face areas and common units. Explain a ray as all positive common multiples; normalizing discards scale unless the divisor is retained. Distinguish an area ray from edge directions or a complete Gram metric.

worked_example.task_and_answer: Synthetic positive areas in bc/ac/ab order are(12,8,6) U^2. Divide by A_bc=12 U^2 to get r=(1,2/3,1/2); retain12 U^2 and the labels to reconstruct all three areas.

guided_practice.task_and_answer: Areas(18,12,9) U^2 give the same ray. Reconstruct with retained A_bc=18 U^2 and distinguish its absolute scale from the worked input.

diagnostic.task_and_answer: Swapping ac and ab gives(1,1/2,2/3), a different ordered ray. Two independent quotients determine the projective AREA triple, not all angles or a unique spatial basis.

teaching_anchor.bridge_to_teach: Recall B->sB with s>0 sends each face area to s^2 times itself. Cancel the same nonzero factor in each quotient; area units cancel.

worked_example.task_and_answer: Length rescale s=2 sends(12,8,6) to(48,32,24) U^2. Ratios remain2/3 and1/2 because(4*A_ac)/(4*A_bc)=A_ac/A_bc and likewise for ab.

guided_practice.task_and_answer: s=1/2 gives areas(3,2,3/2) U^2 with the same ray. Restore original size only if s or a labeled dimensional anchor is retained.

diagnostic.task_and_answer: Scaling only A_ac from8 to9 while keeping the other supplied areas fixed changes the ray to(1,3/4,1/2). This is a ratio perturbation example, not uniform geometric scaling.

diagnostic.task_and_answer: Core check: preserve the exact finite output change and show both eta*alpha and10*A_ac/A_ab agree for the same inputs.
